source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 (debate 16): columns 0 to 15 are indexed by the vectors of GF(2)^4 and the group Z_2^4 acts on them by XOR on the index; column 16 is fixed by the group. The array is the 16 images of each of 6 generator words of 17 bits plus the all-zero and all-one rows (98 rows), found by annealing on one representative of each group orbit of 5-sets (programs/grpm.c with the spec of programs/mkact.py; commands python3 mkact.py Z2^4 1,G 6x1,G,G -o u17_98.spec and grpm 5 u17_98.spec 1 150 5.5 u17_98_s1 -r 40, random start, 0 holes after 112,400 moves, about 1 s; generators in programs/CA_98_5_17_2_gen.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Group-orbit array: the Z_2^4 (XOR) images of 6 generator words on 16 columns plus one fixed column, with both constant rows, found by orbit-class annealing
notes: beats the Torres-Jimenez size 99 (k = 20) at k = 17 by one row; random start, no input array; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; the search programs were written by AI agents for this project
